_comment: npm-script fragment for the LLM Project Operating System. apply.js merges `scripts` and `devDependencies` into the target package.json. Paths are bundle-relative (tooling/, steering/) and assume the bundle was applied at the repo root.

scripts.steering:check: npm run steering:llm:pack && git diff --quiet -- steering/packs
scripts.gate: npm run steering:check && npm run audit:file-size && npm run test:complexity && npm run test:cycles && npm run test:duplication

devDependencies._comment: Per-validator dependency map (verified). NODE-ONLY (no devDep): audit:file-size, check:staged-constant-names, audit:decision-tables, audit:statecharts. NEEDS: test:cycles->madge; test:complexity->eslint; test:complexity:cognitive->eslint+eslint-plugin-sonarjs; test:duplication->jscpd; audit:guideline:* and audit:constant-names->espree+eslint-visitor-keys; test:unused->knip; test:deps->dependency-cruiser; lint->eslint. The Solver engine, the steering-pack generator, and the hooks installer need NONE of these.
